new: /* ---- developer-mode quick switches (local playtest #24, never upstream) -------------------------------------------
The DEV tab floats on the left edge during the PREP phase of a match whose room opted in (room.setExtras devMode);
the panel is pure intent buttons (ui/devPanel.js → g.dev), so it styles itself after the bonds-toggle chip. ---- */
.gm__dev { position: absolute; left: .12rem; top: 52%; z-index: 4; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; }
color: var(--amber); background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); cursor: pointer;
display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .06rem; min-width: 1.5rem; padding: .1rem; pointer-events: auto;
background: rgba(8, 11, 10, .92); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); box-shadow: 0 .06rem .2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
.gm__dev-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .02rem; padding-bottom: .04rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-2); font-size: .16rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--amber); }
min-height: 36px; padding: .05rem .1rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer;
font-size: .15rem; color: var(--text-hi); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .04); border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
